sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:175864
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 31382 of 2024

Applicant :- Deshraj
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Avinash Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Rejoinder affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Avinash Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State.
3. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 307 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Nagal,
District Saharanpur during pendency of the trial.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, he has been made accused in the present matter along with other family members excluding husband of the deceased.
5. He further submits husband of the deceased resided in District Bijnor while deceased resided in District Dehradoon where she was Staff Nurse and applicant resided in District Saharanpur and Deshraj vs State Of U.P. on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25467812/
1 unfortunately on the date of incident deceased came in the house of the applicant and committed suicide.
6.

He further submits, applicant being father-in-law of the deceased was having no concern with the family affairs and as it reflects, deceased was residing separately from her husband in separate district, therefore, under depression she hanged herself.
He further submits, post mortem report also suggests that deceased died due to hanging.

7. He further submits that during trial when parents of the deceased was examined by the trial court as PW-1 and PW-2 then both have been declared hostile and their statements have been annexed along with instant bail application.
8. He further submits that there is no specific allegation against the applicant even in the FIR and he is in jail in the present matter since 01.12.2023 i.e. for last more than eleven months.

9. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and during trial even parents of the deceased have been declared hostile and applicant is in jail since 01.12.2023 i.e. for last more than eleven months.
10. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. Considering the fact that applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and even as per post mortem report deceased died due to hanging and during trial parents of the deceased have been declared hostile and applicant is in jail since 01.12.2023 i.e. for last more than eleven months, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant - Deshraj be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

2 15.

It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
